runtime_usage: lingpet acquire cut-in DISMISS animation (the 획득→클릭 'click' reaction). Resolved by lingpet_acquire_cutin_overlay_host via FALLBACK_CUTIN_DISMISS_SHEET_PATH (maribo has no catalog cutin_dismiss_anim key). Runtime grid: CUTIN_DISMISS_COLS=5, ROWS=5, FRAMES=25. match_to_reveal_contract.must_match: maribo_cutin_anim.png (acquire reveal) in SIZE, POSITION, MOTION, TEXTURE, and COLOR — the reveal->click handoff must read as one continuous shot.
match_to_reveal_contract.size_position: frame0 alpha bbox aligned to the reveal frame0 bbox [0.252,0.1997,0.7759,0.7983]; single fixed transform across all frames.
match_to_reveal_contract.motion: starts at the reveal hold pose (trident diagonal across body), contained flourish (raise trident overhead, feet planted), NO spin / NO size change / NO step toward viewer.
match_to_reveal_contract.texture: Real-ESRGAN realesr-animevideov3 x2 (SAME model as the reveal) — NOT x4plus-anime, which gave a crisper anime-line texture that did not match the reveal's smooth painterly look.
match_to_reveal_contract.color: single Reinhard color transform (body mean+std -> reveal body mean+std, std ratio clamped 0.7-1.4). NO value-contrast punch — the reveal is not punched, so matching means matching its statistics, not boosting. Reveal body mean ~ (181,162,201); matched dismiss body avg ~ (188,169,206) vs the prior x4anime+punch (192,181,216) which read paler/cooler.
